papers.title: Transformers as Support Vector Machines
papers.findings: Fixed head attention ERM; Theorem2 global norm-constrained regularization path distinguishes direct W Frobenius and KQ nuclear norm. Theorems3/5 address direct-W GD under explicit score/support or local-cone conditions. Feasible separability and growing effective linear scores matter.
papers.limits: Only listed definitions/statements/interpretation read. Main proofs, nonlinear-head extension, experiments, implementations and publisher metadata not audited. RP is not an arbitrary finite optimizer trajectory; KQ RP is not a proved GD theorem for the native Born parameterization.

papers.title: Optimizing Attention with Mirror Descent: Generalized Max-Margin Token Selection
papers.findings: Binary one-layer attention. Fixed-head lp-MD update and local-cone small-step Theorems8/10/11; joint training explicitly present. AppendixF Theorem31 concerns global constrained minimizers, logistic loss, feasible attention SVM, AssumptionB label-margin shrinkage, radii r(R)=exp(Theta(R)) and R to infinity. JointGD updates in section3.2 are distinct from JointRP theorem.
papers.limits: Selected setup/statements, section3.2, AppendixF pp49-52 proof read. Other fixed-head proof lemmas, final proof continuation if any, synthetic/real experiments and code not independently audited. JMLR header observed in exact arXiv copy, not separately publisher-verified. Do not describe all prior attention theory as fixed-value only.
